name: National Youth Consultation 2019
content: Problems and Purpose The “National Youth Consultation 2019” was a digital consultation implemented by the Mexican Youth Institute (IMJUVE) with the aim of knowing the opinions and proposals of the Mexican youth regarding the development and future of the youth population. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation The consultation was implemented online through an electronic portal in which young Mexicans between 12 and 29 years old could register. The consultation allowed the participants to express their points of views and suggestions, which were later taken into account to elaborate the national youth policy and draft the National Youth Program 2019-2024.
